items.title: 2.2 Problem-Solving Steps and Algorithms (heading not in the scan)

source_refs.note: Printed page 21 (heading and opening of 2.2, Figure 2.1) is missing from the scan; only the end of the section and Figure 2.2 survive (PDF 26, printed 22). The surviving text is given as printed.

blocks.text: … correct order. This prevents errors during problem solving. Anyone can understand and use the steps easily. Computers also follow step-by-step instructions (as shown in Figure 2.2). Good planning leads to correct results.

blocks.alt: Under the heading Step-by-Step Algorithm Example, a flowchart runs Start, Boil Water, Steep Tea, Add Milk or Lemon, Serve Tea, End, joined by arrows; beside it are pictures of a kettle, a cup of tea with a tea bag, milk with sugar cubes and a lemon, and a cup of tea with lemon.
